notes: Reconstructed from the six per-function legacy sources listed in functions[].legacy_source, which this promotion retires. tubuild create produced the first draft; the shipped TU is a hand-written rewrite of it -- real member access through include/daObjCtMecha10_c.h, real Model / dBgW / dBgW_Kc / SharedFilePtr method calls, and the two shadow structs the draft carried for Render (Base/Derived) deleted.

Class name: the tree carried this class as the coined RotatingCogSmall until the rename that precedes this promotion. The cartridge names it -- ov035's vtable storage at 0x02112af8 has typeinfo word 0x02112a84, whose name word points at 0x02112a90 where overlay_0035.bin reads the length-prefixed string "16daObjCtMecha10_c", and whose base word is _ZTI10dBgActor_c at ov002:0x021089ec. That reading is what gives _ZTI/_ZTS a ROM home and lets the eleven compiler_only_output rows below resolve as deadstrip-data.

Destructor form: ~daObjCtMecha10_c is inline and empty in include/daObjCtMecha10_c.h. Written out of line mwccarm emits the synthesized D0 ahead of the written D1 -- the reverse of the cartridge -- and the object audit refuses a TU whose licensed .text is not ROM-ascending; it also emits a homeless D2 that then needs its own deadstrip row. Inlining moves the key function to InitResources, lets vtable slots 16 and 17 odr-use D1 then D0 in ROM order, and deletes the D2. Same form as include/daObjBk_Lift_c.h, the same dBgActor_c shape. Measured both ways on this TU: out of line the audit refused with emitted order [D0, D1, ...]; inline it reports all six ROM-ascending.

Codegen levers, both measured by removing them and re-verifying: InitResources widens each actorID test into one reused int local before branching on it, and CleanupResources widens its own; folding either test straight into its `if` re-orders the body and DIFFs (InitResources 9 relocation destinations wrong, CleanupResources 1). A third temp the draft carried -- `int st = mRotationState` before the table read -- was measured NOT load-bearing and was dropped.

Deliberately left mangled: dBgW_KcMbg::SetFile and dBgActor_c::IsClsnInRange each take Fix12<int> by value, and a real method call homes the argument and size-DIFFs the caller (the wall 6az that include/dBgW_KcMbg.h and src/actors/daObjBk_Lift_c.cpp both record). _Z14ApproachLinearRsss, DecIfAbove0_Short, RandomIntInternal, func_020393d4 and func_020396c0 have no header home and keep their linker names.

This entry licenses .text, .init, .ctor, and the resource .bss. ov035's .data is not claimed here, so the class vtable and the whole __si_class_type_info chain the compiler drags in with it are compiler-only output, each row naming the cartridge copy it duplicates.

They are the CT_MECHA12S/CT_MECHA12L/CT_MECHA10 registry profiles' factories and sit immediately after InitResources in the ROM's .text order with daObjCtMecha11_c (a different class) starting immediately after them, so they were always part of this TU. compiler_only_output.reason: compiler-emitted base-object destructor helper, homeless: `return new daObjCtMecha10_c()` in each of the three folded classInit factories generates a base-destructor call for the exception-unwind path in case construction fails partway. daObjCtMecha10_c declares no constructor of its own, so this is the compiler-synthesized default constructor's cleanup helper for the dBgActor_c base sub-object. It has no configured ROM symbol and no inbound relocation after the licensed D1/D0 pair is retained -- same shape as ov022/daObjFl_Fall_Block_c (PR #2733).

This TU owns daObjCtMecha10_c's key function -- ~daObjCtMecha10_c is the first virtual the class declares and its body is out of line here -- so mwcc emits the complete 0x88-byte class vtable storage with its two-word ABI preamble. The cartridge's public address point is ov035:0x02112b00, eight bytes above the start of storage at 0x02112af8, where the offset-to-top word reads 0 and the typeinfo word reads 0x02112a84. The address point is outside this text-only entry's licensed 0x021111a0..0x021116ec range, so dsd supplies that ROM data independently. The cartridge's 32 slots place all six non-factory members of this TU: slot 0 InitResources (0x021114e0), slot 3 CleanupResources (0x0211123c), slot 6 Behavior (0x021112ec), slot 9 Render (0x021112c4), slot 16 D1 (0x021111a0) and slot 17 D0 (0x021111e4); the three classInit factories are free functions reached through the actor registry, not vtable slots. 32 slots is the dBgActor_c vtable length, which is the second witness for the base the typeinfo record names.

This class's own RTTI record, dragged in by the vtable this TU emits: the vtable's typeinfo word at 0x02112afc points straight at it. The canonical cartridge copy at ov035:0x02112a84 lies in this overlay's .data and outside this text-only entry's licensed range, so it stays ROM-gap owned. Its three words read 0x0209a764 (the __si_class_type_info vtable), 0x02112a90 (the name string) and 0x021089ec (_ZTI10dBgActor_c), which is the second independent witness that dBgActor_c is the base.

This class's RTTI name string, emitted with the record above. The canonical cartridge copy is ov035:0x02112a90, nineteen bytes reading 31 36 64 61 4f 62 6a 43 74 4d 65 63 68 61 31 30 5f 63 00 -- the length-prefixed mangled string "16daObjCtMecha10_c". That is why the class is spelled daObjCtMecha10_c and why no part of this name is coined; the row resolves as deadstrip-data rather than the never-compared plain deadstrip precisely because the spelling reaches symbols.txt.
